documents.title: Authentication Policy
documents.text:
# Login
Refresh token rotation occurs after login. Session expiration is 30 minutes.

documents.title: DICOM Integration
documents.text:
# DICOM
C-STORE delivers medical images to the PACS archive. Orthanc stores study instances.

documents.title: Audit Records
documents.text:
# Audit
Patient access records are preserved for 180 days for auditing and compliance.
